name: Hario Mini Mill Slim
details: Slim hand grinder with ceramic conical burrs; clicks counted from zero.

rangeInfo.note: Honest Coffee Guide's chart (community, not the manufacturer's): Turkish 1, espresso 1–3, moka pot 4–8, AeroPress 3–13, V60 5–8, filter coffee machine 3–12, French press 9–18, cold brew 11–20. Its V60 row is used for pour-over, “Filter Coffee Machine” for drip, French press for immersion.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
